slots.title: Factory output up 2.2% year over year
slots.body:
Industrial production — total factory, mine, and utility output — rose **2.2%** in September from a year ago.

Economists’ median forecast: **1.0%**.

August’s pace: **1.6%**.

Manufacturing alone: **+0.3%** month over month, matching the **0.3%** estimate after **−0.2%** in August.

Capacity utilization — how much of U.S. industrial capacity is in use — **76.9%**, vs **76.5%** expected and **76.4%** prior.

Release time: **Oct. 16, 1:15 p.m.
ET**.
